text: Someone made a Titanic game, and the developer is called White Star Line.
That's the company that owned the real ship.
Titanic. You own the ship, pick the route, and carry three classes of passengers.
Southampton to New York is on the map. So are the ice fields.
The demo is about two point seven gigabytes, and almost all of it sits in one single file.
It also carries Dynamic Water Physics, a Unity plugin that makes boats float.
Worth a dip. Just watch for icebergs.
That's Demo Dip. A new Steam demo, every day.
